experiment: v8 stronger extractor: Azure gpt-5.6-luna replaces qwen3.5:4b-mlx for extraction only
hypothesis: With the prompt, parser, validation retries, verifier, embeddings, gate, identity and scorer unchanged, a stronger extraction model completely retrieves more of the 23 distinct development targets than qwen3.5:4b-mlx without any unsupported historical write.

single_variable.changed: extraction model and its transport: Azure OpenAI v1 deployment gpt-5.6-luna (responses must report gpt-5.6-luna or gpt-5.6-luna-*), reasoning_effort=none, max_completion_tokens=2048, response_format=json_object
unchanged: initial system prompt and message construction (_extraction_messages; prompt sha256 below)
output schema, exact-evidence validation, extractor_max_retries=2 and final-batch recovery (inherited OpenAIExtractor.extract)
full-turn verifier: cross-encoder NLI with qwen3.5:4b-mlx Ollama fallback
nomic-embed-text embeddings, gate thresholds, provenance/trust, identity, tiering and retrieval query protocol
equivalence-v2 scorer, frozen 20-source development selection and labels
single_variable.temperature_rule: temperature=0 is sent unless Azure rejects it with HTTP 400 on the synthetic smoke call; then it is omitted for the whole run. Decided before any call.
single_variable.not_isolated: The two models also differ in provider, serving stack and determinism; qwen's own run-to-run variation was observed in v7. One run cannot separate these.

policy_note: The policy fingerprint hashes core/config/models source, which changed after the v6 baseline (direct API, hash guards, revert refactor; no gate logic). The gate configuration equals v7's. The control phase measures the frozen qwen candidates under today's code to expose any drift.

budget.paid_phase: extraction only; control, replay and score are local and free
budget.enforcement: checked before every request (smoke, initial, validation retry, infrastructure retry); on exhaustion further turns record errors, the partial report is kept, and nothing is rerun
budget.infrastructure_retries: at most 2 per request for HTTP 429/5xx or transport errors, counted against the cap
budget.reference: v7 qwen extraction used 26 requests, 26,208 input + 5,110 output tokens

phases: blind reviews (source-review.json, mustkeep-review.json) written before any replay output exists
control (frozen v5 qwen candidates, today's code)
score (unchanged equivalence-v2; v6 reviews for control)
review_protocol: Primary agent judges every Luna candidate against its source (supported/unsupported/ambiguous) and every must-keep occurrence (complete/partial/none/ambiguous) using the v6/v7 rubrics, before the control or Luna replay runs. The runner refuses the Luna replay until both review files exist and records their hashes. Provisional agent judgments, not human gold. The two locked ambiguous targets stay ambiguous with zero credit.

success_requires_all: Luna complete distinct retrieved targets > 16 (frozen v6 baseline)
Luna complete distinct retrieved targets > same-code control
zero unsupported gated historical writes (ambiguous reported separately)
decision_rule.on_success: Record the result. Supporting Azure as a production extractor option is a separate, later decision; no threshold, prompt or identity change follows automatically.
decision_rule.on_failure: Record the result. No prompt tuning, rerun or second model follows from this protocol.
decision_rule.incomplete_extraction: If the probe is incomplete (budget or infrastructure), the replay cannot run; the outcome is recorded as failure with the partial evidence.

holdout: b46e15ed remains sealed; no holdout content is read.
limits: 20 selected development turns, one run, provisional agent reviews; no generalization, conversation-wide, later-session or post-TTL claim.
